text:
Aisha: Quick thread to nail exit criteria + partner incentives for the pilot cohort. Need final by Friday.
Sam: +1. Key Q: what converts a pilot to a paid contract?
Zoe: From CS: clear ROI signal + shared success metric hit (e.g., 20% reduction in failure rate or 10% latency improvement) + willingness to sign SLA.
Neil: ML: also want a quality delta threshold. If model improvements are neutral or negative on canonical prompts, we shouldn't push conversion. Propose improvement >=3% on primary metric.
Tara: Marketing/sales: offer a conversion incentive: 20% first-year discount or 3 months free on annual contract if they opt-in to a case study. :sparkles:
Priya: Legal: discounts fine but need to avoid language that guarantees outcomes. We can tie incentive to partner-provided metric confirmation and a sign-off process.
Josh: Ops: infrastructure credit for costs incurred during pilot? We could grant $X credits to cover token usage during pilot, capped per-partner, to make acceptance easier.
Eli: Engineering: if a partner requests scope creep (more integrations / features) during pilot, we should require a change request doc and reprioritization. No extra dev without written approval.
Aisha: Draft exit matrix (short):
- Convert: partner signs SLA + meets agreed success metric(s) + legal MOU signed.
- Extend: partner wants more tuning but shows directional improvement; add 2-week extension & capped eng hours.
- Pause/No-go: model regression >5% on primary prompts or error rate >1.5% sustained 24h.
Sam: Add a 'high-value' bypass: if partner is strategic (enterprise logo), allow exec review to convert even if metric gap small, but require a mitigation plan.
Zoe: CS will own partner sign-off form: fields for final metrics, business contact, procurement timeline. I'll template it.
Tara: Incentive tiers idea:
- public case study opt-in -> 3 months free + feature-priority bump
- anonymized success data only -> 1 month free
- no public use -> no discount (but get credits)
Neil: For measurement: store baseline and pilot outputs in S3 and run diffs with our eval harness (weekly snapshots). We'll post a short report at pilot end.
CS-bot: (link) pilot exit template: https://redwood.example/pilot-exit-template
Priya: Contract clause: pilot credits and discounts contingent on timely invoice/payment post-conversion. Also include a data-retention window (default 30 days).
Josh: Ops action items: expose cost cap per partner token key, log usage to per-partner dashboard, and implement an auto-alert if cost > 80% cap.
Eli: Change request process: issue a PR-like doc: title, scope delta, eng hours estimate, stakeholder signoff. No dev work starts until approved.
Aisha: Nice. One sticky point: partners requesting private deployment during pilot. Decision?
Priya: Private dep needs separate legal review and security checklist. We'll treat it as "private track" and exclude from standard conversion incentives unless approved.
Sam: Prioritization: if partner feature request gets >3 partner votes in the cohort we can fast-track into roadmap backlog with an "explore" ticket.
Tara: We'll make that explicit in outreach: "feature asks may be considered for product backlog; votes across cohort inform prioritization."
Zoe: Post-pilot: schedule a 1-hour outcomes workshop with partner + internal review (30m CS, 30m PM+Eng).
Neil: Also include a 10-sample human review set to sanity-check automated diffs.
Aisha: Owners: Sam=conversion rubric + strategic bypass, Zoe=sign-off form + outcomes workshop, Josh=cost caps + alerts, Neil=eval artifacts + final report, Priya=legal clauses, Eli=change request template, Tara=incentive copy for outreach. I'll assemble final doc.
CS-bot: (reminder) create-event /pilot-outcomes <partner>
Aisha: If no objections by EOD Friday, we'll publish the exit criteria and incentives in the pilot playbook. Please react with :thumbsup: if you're good.
Sam: :thumbsup:
Neil: :thumbsup: (ML)
Tara: :thumbsup: comms
Josh: :thumbsup: infra
Priya: :thumbsup: legal
Zoe: :thumbsup: CS
Eli: :thumbsup: eng
Aisha: Thanks all  I'll post the consolidated playbook link here once it's live.
